title: How many times was the budget in Advertisement for "Yearly Kickoff" meeting
question:
How many times was the budget in Advertisement for "Yearly Kickoff" meeting more than "October Meeting"?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: budget in Advertisement refer to category = 'Advertisement' in the budget table; DIVIDE(SUM(amount when event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'), SUM(amount when event_name = 'October Meeting'))

prediction.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_011 = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.XCL_005 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_011 = 'October Meeting' THEN b.XCL_005 ELSE 0 END) FROM budget AS "b" JOIN event AS "e" ON "b".XCL_009 = "e".XCL_010 WHERE b.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement' AND e.XCL_011 IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting')

arguments.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_011 = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.XCL_005 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_011 = 'October Meeting' THEN b.XCL_005 ELSE 0 END)
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.XCL_009 = e.XCL_010
WHERE b.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement'
  AND e.XCL_011 IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting');

columns: SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_011 = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.XCL_005 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN e.XCL_011 = 'October Meeting' THEN b.XCL_005 ELSE 0 END)
